data.gender_notes: Munaziyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the 55th chapter of the Quran, symbolizing the resurrection and the afterlife. The name Munaziyah carries the meaning “Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munaziyah usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Munaziyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resurrection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munaziyah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

In modern times, the name is used in various Muslim cultures, and it is considered a beautiful and meaningful name.

This Chapter 55, referred to as Al-Qasas, contains many reminders and stories about the divine punishment, which emphasizes the importance of good deeds and fearing Allah. Its very existence acts as a daily reminder for Muslims to lead virtuous lives, in this world and the next.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Munaziyah carries immense spiritual significance for Muslims in light of its association with Surah Al-Qasas. The passage from this surah references the account of Prophet Moses' encounters with Pharaoh, a narrative designed to instill a deep appreciation of Allah's omnipotence and justice. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of upholding strong faith and fearing God – serving as powerful reminders for the spiritual journey and ultimate goal of seeking closer closeness with Allah.
